items.name: Apple
items.fact: Apples come in red, green, and yellow and are very healthy

items.name: Banana
items.fact: Bananas are yellow when ripe and give you lots of energy

items.name: Mango
items.fact: Mangoes are called the King of Fruits and taste delicious

items.name: Strawberry
items.fact: Strawberries are red, sweet, and shaped like a little heart

items.name: Watermelon
items.fact: Watermelons are mostly water and very refreshing in summer

items.name: Grapes
items.fact: Grapes grow in big bunches and can be red or green

items.name: Orange
items.fact: Oranges are full of Vitamin C which keeps us healthy

items.name: Pineapple
items.fact: Pineapples have a spiky crown and grow on low plants near the ground

items.name: Cherry
items.fact: Cherries are tiny red fruits that grow in pairs on trees

items.name: Kiwi
items.fact: Kiwi fruits are brown outside and bright green inside

items.name: Peach
items.fact: Peaches have fuzzy skin and sweet juicy flesh inside

items.name: Pear
items.fact: Pears are shaped like teardrops and are sweet and juicy

items.name: Lemon
items.fact: Lemons are very sour and full of Vitamin C

items.name: Lime
items.fact: Limes are small green citrus fruits used in drinks and cooking

items.name: Coconut
items.fact: Coconuts are large tropical fruits full of refreshing water inside

items.name: Papaya
items.fact: Papayas are tropical fruits with orange flesh and black seeds

items.name: Blueberry
items.fact: Blueberries are tiny blue berries packed with powerful antioxidants

items.name: Raspberry
items.fact: Raspberries are delicate red berries that grow on thorny bushes

items.name: Blackberry
items.fact: Blackberries are dark purple berries that grow wild in hedgerows

items.name: Plum
items.fact: Plums are juicy purple fruits that can be dried to make prunes

items.name: Pomegranate
items.fact: Pomegranates are filled with hundreds of tiny red jewel-like seeds

items.name: Guava
items.fact: Guavas have pink flesh and are extremely rich in Vitamin C

items.name: Lychee
items.fact: Lychees have a bumpy pink shell and a sweet white fruit inside

items.name: Dragonfruit
items.fact: Dragon fruit has a bright pink skin with white speckled flesh inside

items.name: Passion Fruit
items.fact: Passion fruits have a wrinkly purple shell and tangy yellow seeds inside

items.name: Fig
items.fact: Figs are one of the oldest cultivated fruits in human history

items.name: Date
items.fact: Dates are very sweet sticky fruits that grow on palm trees

items.name: Apricot
items.fact: Apricots are small orange fruits similar to peaches but less fuzzy

items.name: Grapefruit
items.fact: Grapefruits are large citrus fruits with a bitter sweet taste

items.name: Tangerine
items.fact: Tangerines are small easy-to-peel oranges with a sweet flavor

items.name: Cantaloupe
items.fact: Cantaloupes are round melons with orange flesh and a sweet fragrance

items.name: Honeydew
items.fact: Honeydew melons have pale green flesh and are very sweet

items.name: Starfruit
items.fact: When you cut a starfruit sideways it makes a perfect star shape

items.name: Jackfruit
items.fact: Jackfruit is the largest fruit that grows on a tree, sometimes over 80 pounds

items.name: Durian
items.fact: Durian is called the King of Tropical Fruits but has a very strong smell

items.name: Rambutan

items.name: Longan
items.fact: Longans are called Dragon Eye fruit and taste like sweet honey

items.name: Tamarind
items.fact: Tamarind is a sour brown pod fruit used in cooking and drinks worldwide

items.name: Mulberry
items.fact: Mulberries look like elongated blackberries and stain your fingers purple

items.name: Elderberry
items.fact: Elderberries are dark purple berries used in syrups and medicine

items.name: Gooseberry
items.fact: Gooseberries are small tart berries that grow on spiny bushes

items.name: Persimmon
items.fact: Persimmons are bright orange fruits that taste like honey when very ripe

items.name: Kumquat
items.fact: Kumquats are tiny orange fruits you eat whole including the sweet skin

items.name: Quince
items.fact: Quinces are golden yellow fruits too hard to eat raw but wonderful cooked

items.name: Breadfruit
items.fact: Breadfruit got its name because its starchy flesh tastes like freshly baked bread

items.name: Nectarine
items.fact: Nectarines are like peaches but with smooth shiny skin instead of fuzzy

items.name: Ugli Fruit
items.fact: Ugli fruit has a wrinkled ugly outside but a sweet delicious inside

items.name: Ackee
items.fact: Ackee is the national fruit of Jamaica and must be ripe before eating safely

items.name: Cherimoya
items.fact: Cherimoya is called the custard apple because its flesh is creamy and sweet

items.name: Soursop

items.name: Carambola
items.fact: Carambola is another name for starfruit which makes star shapes when sliced

items.name: Feijoa
items.fact: Feijoas smell like tropical perfume and taste like a mix of guava and mint

items.name: Mangosteen
items.fact: Mangosteen is called the Queen of Fruits with a sweet tangy white interior

items.name: Salak
items.fact: Salak is called snake fruit because of its scaly brown skin

items.name: Sapodilla
items.fact: Sapodilla tastes like a pear soaked in brown sugar and caramel

items.name: Cupuacu

items.name: Miracle Fruit
items.fact: Miracle fruit makes sour foods taste sweet after you eat it

items.name: Pitahaya

items.name: Pomelo
items.fact: Pomelos are the largest citrus fruit in the world with thick fluffy rind

items.name: Buddha's Hand
items.fact: Buddha's Hand citrus fruit has finger-like segments and smells amazing

items.name: Calamansi
items.fact: Calamansi are tiny citrus fruits popular in Southeast Asian cooking

items.name: Cloudberry
items.fact: Cloudberries grow in Arctic regions and are golden orange when ripe

items.name: Boysenberry
items.fact: Boysenberries are a cross between raspberries, blackberries, and loganberries

items.name: Acerola

items.name: Pitanga

items.name: Bael
items.fact: Bael fruit has a hard woody shell and a fragrant sticky pulp inside

items.name: Rose Apple

items.name: Wax Apple

items.name: Jujube

items.name: Pawpaw

items.name: Langsat
items.fact: Langsats grow in grape-like clusters and taste sweet with a hint of grapefruit

items.name: Ilama

items.name: Pummelo

items.name: Natal Plum

items.name: Ice Cream Bean
items.fact: Ice cream beans are long pods filled with cotton candy-like white pulp

items.name: Rollinia
items.fact: Rollinia is a tropical fruit with a bumpy yellow skin and lemony cream flesh

items.fact: Black sapote is nicknamed the chocolate pudding fruit for its dark rich flesh

items.name: Mamoncillo

items.name: Genip
items.fact: Genips are tropical fruits with firm green skin and sweet orange flesh

items.name: Kiwano

items.name: Tamarillo
items.fact: Tamarillos are also called tree tomatoes and are eaten with a spoon

items.name: Pepino

items.fact: Uva ursi or bearberry produces small red fruits eaten by bears and birds

items.name: Sea Buckthorn
items.fact: Sea buckthorn berries are extremely sour orange berries rich in Vitamin C

items.name: Barberry
items.fact: Barberries are tiny tart red berries used in Persian rice dishes and jams

items.name: Hackberry
items.fact: Hackberries are small purple-brown wild berries with a sweet date-like flavor

items.name: Salmonberry
items.fact: Salmonberries are Pacific Northwest berries ranging from yellow to deep red
